obligations.note: The change replaces the audit record call (audit.record(actor, Action.EDIT_CASE, caseId, "document_received:" + document)) in markDocumentReceived with a log.info call. markDocumentReceived is a state-changing operation (it mutates the loan case and persists it via store.save), and EDIT_CASE is listed as a state_changing_action in the access policy. Removing the audit event violates the universal obligation that every state-changing operation records an audit event with actor, action, target and time.

The new log.info line logs a DocumentType enum value and a case ID, neither of which is NPI (no SSN, account number, DOB, income, or other nonpublic personal information). No NPI leakage is introduced.
Ticket CHG-24798 is approved by change manager grace.kim and its component list includes 'mortgage.cases', which matches the component of CaseService.java in components.json.

Declan Farrell (declan.farrell@fernbrook.example) holds the change_approver role for baseline-mortgage and is not the author (Wen Li). His code_review approval on the head commit satisfies independent approval.
The approval names commit 3bf58db47e70699aef10cd32dd649fc854fe99ae, which is the sole (and head) commit of the change. No later commits exist, so the approval fully covers what is merged.

CI ran on the final commit 3bf58db… with result 'success': 124 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. All registered mortgage control tests (including controls.AuditControlTest#sampledOperationsAreAudited for AUD-1) are present and unskipped.
The changed file CaseService.java maps to component 'mortgage.cases', which is marked security_sensitive: false in components.json. No security_review approval is required.
CaseService.java is not within any protected path (controls/*, ci/*, or test-controls directories). No control_owner approval is required.
Ticket CHG-24798 is of type 'standard', not 'emergency'. The post-implementation review requirement does not apply.
No exception is invoked or needed for this change; no deviation from a product obligation is being claimed under an exception.
No entry in the acceptance ledger covers apps/baseline-mortgage/src/main/java/mortgage/CaseService.java, so no prior evidence lapses due to this change.

summary: The change removes the audit event recording from the markDocumentReceived method in CaseService.java, replacing it with a plain log.info call. markDocumentReceived is a state-changing operation (it modifies and persists the loan case), and EDIT_CASE is classified as state-changing in the access policy, so AUD-1 (every state-changing operation must record an audit event with actor, action, target, and time) is directly violated. The process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-4, LAP-1) are all satisfied, and no NPI is introduced into logs (LOG-1). However, the violation of the critical AUD-1 obligation is sufficient to require rejection; the change must be reverted or the audit record restored before it can be merged.
